method: five alternating-order wall-time samples after 10% warmup; lookup100k,compile10k,construct+compile2k calls; lookup constructs a fresh Parser and invokes arity2 twice per cursor

hill27.reason: A fresh-parser double-lookahead microbenchmark exposes the possible reuse, but representative compile totals show only small, uneven gains while each Parser gains mutable cache state and a wrapper branch. The standard arithmetic/rules workloads do not show a convincing improvement. Keep the smaller bucketed lookup.

hill31.reason: A <=8 linear-table prototype regresses lookup/compile for four/eight operator vocabularies. One/two token cases sometimes improve construction, but adding a second lookup representation and a branch on every operator does not show a convincing overall benefit. Retain bucketed tables uniformly.

qualification_note: 19 value/error/span scenarios per variant agree: symbol/word registries at 1,2,4,8,16,100 operators plus seven standard/function/nesting/adjacency/lazy/error scenarios.
